verdict.rationale: Finix offers webhooks that send programmatic notifications when API resources are created or updated. Webhooks can be managed via API or Dashboard, with 30-day logs and in-app notification subscriptions. These are event notifications only, so any automated action must be built in the user's own external code; there is no evidence of a native rules engine. missing for 10: native user-defined rule/trigger-action configuration, event-condition filtering logic, built-in automated actions on events, independent corroboration.
